sections.name: About Us
sections.copy: Mikcoson Leasing Limited, also operating as Mikcoson Equipment Finance Co, is a leading financial services institution specializing in equipment leasing and asset financing across Nigeria. Based in Umuada Obehie Asa, we serve businesses nationwide with tailored financial solutions that drive operational efficiency and business expansion. Under the experienced leadership of our Trust Company Director, we have built a reputation for integrity, transparency, and deep understanding of Nigerian business needs. Whether you're in construction, manufacturing, agriculture, healthcare, or technology, we structure financing packages that align with your cash flow and growth objectives. Our mission is simple: to remove financial barriers and give Nigerian enterprises the tools they need to compete and thrive in today's economy.

sections.name: Our Financing Process
sections.copy: Step 1 - Initial Consultation: Contact us via phone or WhatsApp to discuss your equipment needs and business situation. Step 2 - Application Submission: Complete our straightforward application form with your business registration documents, CAC papers, and financial statements. Step 3 - Equipment Evaluation: Our team assesses the equipment value, useful life, and suitability for your business operations. Step 4 - Credit Assessment: We review your business credit history, cash flow projections, and collateral (if required). Step 5 - Approval & Terms: Receive your customized financing proposal with clear payment schedules and terms. Step 6 - Documentation: Sign the lease agreement and complete all legal formalities with our guidance. Step 7 - Equipment Delivery: We facilitate equipment procurement from approved suppliers or release funds for your purchase. Step 8 - Ongoing Support: Throughout the lease period, we provide account management and flexible restructuring if business conditions change.

sections.name: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.copy: What types of businesses qualify for equipment financing? We work with registered Nigerian businesses across all sectors - from sole proprietorships to limited liability companies. What documents do I need? Typically: CAC business registration, tax clearance certificates, 6-12 months bank statements, director's ID, and equipment quotation. What is the minimum and maximum financing amount? We finance equipment from ₦500,000 to ₦50,000,000 depending on business profile and equipment type. Do you require collateral? Requirements vary by deal size. For amounts under ₦5 million, personal guarantees may suffice. Larger transactions may require asset-backed security. Can I buy the equipment at the end of the lease? Yes, most agreements include a buyout option at fair market value or a predetermined residual amount. What if my business faces temporary cash flow challenges? We offer payment holidays and restructuring options for clients experiencing genuine business difficulties. How long does approval take? Initial assessment within 48 hours. Complete approval and documentation typically 7-14 working days. Do you finance used equipment? Yes, we finance both new and quality pre-owned equipment up to certain age limits depending on asset type.
